terms.comment: The ancient name, Gaul, which later Latin keeps for France. A country takes a preposition: in Galliam (to), in Galliā (in), ē Galliā (from).

evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Frankreich: Francia, Gallia
terms.comment: The name from the Franks, used of medieval and modern France (M-O).
